vpc_architecture_fit: Preferred topology: single-account private deployment in eu-west-1 with isolated private subnets for inference nodes, NAT/egress via controlled NAT GW for host updates, VPC endpoints (S3, ECR) for model fetch, optional Transit Gateway for cross-account connectivity to analytics cluster. Strict egress allowlist; no public ingress except through customer-managed ALB in a DMZ. BYOK via cross-account KMS grants or HSM-backed keys; audit logs forwarded to customer SIEM via Customer CloudWatch/Log Forwarder.
notes:
- Initial qualification focused on Private VPC deployment and compliance fit.
- Quote from SecOps: "We need EU residency end-to-end, and zero plaintext model telemetry leaving region."
- Main workloads: customer-facing chat assistant (low latency), embeddings for search, and reranker for fraud signals.
- Latency & throughput: p95 <= 100ms for chat, sustain 300 concurrent sessions, burst to 600. Cost-sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay premium for strict residency + KMS BYOK.
- Security asks: BYOK/HSM integration, full audit trail for every request (token-level logs), configurable retention policies, SSO (SAML) integration with Okta, penetration test report, and SOC2/ISO27001 evidence.
- Network notes: want no public IPs on inference nodes; outbound only to pinned endpoints (S3, ECR, model-repo), prefer VPC endpoint or PrivateLink. Consider Transit Gateway to central infra account for metrics/observability.
- POC asks: 1) run 2-week smoke POC in eu-west-1, 2) demonstrate reranking pipeline with cached KV layer, 3) show KMS key rotation without service downtime.
- Sales notes: pre-reqs for procurement - security FAQ, SOW, expected SLA, pricing for reserved capacity. Legal: add EU-only data residency clause + breach notification timeline.
- Quote from CTO during workshop: "If Redwood can guarantee auditability and BYOK without major infra changes on our side, we want to convert to a 12–18 month reserved commitment."
qualification_summary: Fit: high. Clear enterprise security posture, EU residency required. Architecture fit: compatible with Redwood Private VPC model with BYOK.
